title: Who Gets Unmasked? Sampler-Induced Bias in Diffusion Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the gender distribution of generated protagonists in Winogender occupational stories against U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data and the model's internal probability beliefs, as well as evaluating the misgendering rates of neopronouns (e.g., xe, ey, fae) using the TANGO dataset.

Evaluating the collapse of diverse subjective opinions into a single majority response by measuring the distribution of generated multiple-choice answers on the GlobalOpinionQA dataset against the model's internal belief distribution.
